RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-male panel is worth noting, but it does not establish that sex influenced the decision. Your stronger academic qualifications matter, but leadership, regulatory expertise and other job criteria may also matter; an announcement cannot reveal the full comparison.

Follow up in writing on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, your assessment against them, and the reasons for the decision. You can neutrally ask how the bank ensured a fair process, including panel composition.

Keep records. If the explanation reveals inconsistent criteria or sex-based assumptions, consider an equality adviser or employment lawyer. Check local complaint deadlines now; awaiting a response may not pause them.
